summary: Reproduced the parallel-sampling LoRA usage-counter imbalance in the actual TokenizerManager._handle_batch_request implementation: one n=4 prompt released 5 references after 4 acquisitions, and two n=3 prompts released 8 after 6. The prefix-cache warm-up request inherited LoRA ownership despite having no separately acquired reference. The fix keeps the scheduler-side LoRA identity for cache correctness but clears LoRA ownership from the warm-up request's tokenizer-side completion state. The regression passes after the change and covers single-sample and multi-prompt boundaries.

tests.what_was_measured: Recorded-base implementation failed the issue-specific accounting assertions: 5 releases for 4 acquired references and 8 releases for 6 acquired references; n=1 passed. Raw output: reports/j-6fcda1eec5fe/raw/regression-before.log
All three lifecycle tests passed after the fix: n=4 single prompt, n=3 with two prompts, and the n=1 boundary. Raw output: reports/j-6fcda1eec5fe/raw/regression-after.log
Changed source and regression test compile successfully.

One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950) executed a deterministic 3x4 by 4x2 float32 matrix multiplication with maximum absolute error 0.0 against the independent CPU result. Raw output: reports/j-6fcda1eec5fe/raw/gpu-smoke.log

gpu_execution.evidence: Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 detected exactly one AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, and the independent CPU/GPU matrix results matched exactly. This only establishes assigned-GPU execution, not a serving reproduction.

remaining_limitations: The reported Qwen3.5-0.8B model and rank-128 LoRA adapter weights were not available, so the full HTTP serving deadlock was not reproduced on that architecture.

The deterministic regression executes the actual checked-out _handle_batch_request source with controlled request lifecycle doubles; it validates reference accounting and the warm-up/real-request split, not model semantics.
The available tiny Llama fixture cannot qualify the reported Qwen hybrid-attention architecture or its adapter, so it was not presented as a substitute reproduction.
No native C++ or FlyDSL source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
The prepared environment has no ruff module or executable; compileall and the focused regression were used for source validation.
